lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four primary horizontal rows extending from the posterior of the gills to the caudal peduncle, with higher spatial density observed in the region dorsal to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating a defined grid-like arrangement across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are visible along the upper flank, displaying a distinct vertical intensity gradient with specular highlights on the upper edge and shadowing on the lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, low-contrast high-luminance blobs localized primarily on the posterior half of the first dorsal fin's lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the primary pectoral fin exhibits a high-density population of smaller, high-contrast white spots relative to the lateral flank pattern.
